title: Dispatch: a full worker is skipped, and the job runs in the other
design_ref: Sending work to the right cluster
purpose: Fill one CPU worker for a team, then submit that team's job to the hub. The hub offers it to both workers and the one with room must win.

steps.display: kubectl --context cpu-a create -f job.yaml   # llm/fill-cpu-a: queue cpu, 4 pod(s) x cpu 1
scripts/fleet-status.py queues   # cpu-a's llm queue is full (4 of 4 CPUs)

steps.display: kubectl --context hub create -f job.yaml   # llm/needs-3: queue cpu, 3 pod(s) x cpu 1
kubectl --context hub -n llm get workload -o custom-columns=<name, chosen cluster, nominated clusters>
kubectl --context cpu-a -n llm get workloads   # only the job that fills it; no copy of needs-3
steps.output:
NAME                   QUEUE   RESERVED IN   ADMITTED   FINISHED   AGE
job-fill-cpu-a-067eb   cpu     llm-cpu       True                  20s

checks.description: the job was sent to cpu-b, the worker with room
checks.because: Both workers were offered the job. cpu-a's llm queue had no room, so only cpu-b could admit it (chosen: cpu-b).

checks.description: the full worker holds no copy of the job any more
checks.because: As soon as one worker admits, the hub deletes the copies in the others.
